newsitem.title: POLAND: Relpol sees 1996 net at PLN 5.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: Relpol sees 1996 net at PLN 5.9 mln.

text.p: Polish electromagnetic transmitter producer Relpol SA expects to make a net profit of about 5.9 million zlotys this year, the company's president said on Tuesday.
Relpol, which netted 4.4 million zlotys last year, has earned 3.5 million zlotys over the first eight months of 1996.
"We plan a profit this year of around 5.9 million zlotys though of course there can be a deviation of up to 10 percent," Krzysztof Prucnal told Reuters.

Prucnal said sales should be about 15 percent lower than the the planned 49 million zlotys because of lower demand in Germany due to the business downturn there, but that this would be made up by financial operations such as forward contracts.
He also said Relpol was exploring markets in the major former Soviet republics to make up for lower German demand.

Prucnal said the firm had already spent two million zlotys of its nine-million-zloty investment programme aimed largely at producing miniature electromagnetic transmitters, sales of which would begin in the first quarter of next year.
